# formal_log_schema (Resource)

Defines field-level actions for matching Formal logs before they are exported or stored.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of this log schema.
- `path` (Block Set, Min: 1) A log field path and the actions to apply to it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--path))
- `scope_cel` (String) A CEL expression that determines which logs this schema applies to.

### Optional

- `encryption_key_id` (String) The ID of the asymmetric encryption key used by encrypt actions.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the log schema was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this log schema.
- `updated_at` (String) When the log schema was last updated.

<a id="nestedblock--path"></a>
### Nested Schema for `path`

Required:

- `name` (String) The protobuf field path, starting with `log`.

Optional:

- `drop` (Boolean) Whether to remove the field from the log.
- `encrypt` (Boolean) Whether to encrypt the string field.
- `encrypt_sql` (Boolean) Whether to encrypt literal values in a SQL query.
- `strip_sql` (Boolean) Whether to remove literal values from a SQL query.
- `truncate` (Block List, Max: 1) Truncates the string field to a maximum UTF-8 byte length. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--path--truncate))

<a id="nestedblock--path--truncate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `path.truncate`

Required:

- `max_size_bytes` (Number) The maximum field size in bytes.



<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
